text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I was looking at all sortsa<n>Umatter posts
about myself...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I kept searching for stuff like "Windy<n>cool" and
"Windy evil"—anything I<n>could think of...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And the next thing I knew, it was past<n>midnight...
Actually, I've been doin'<n>that a lot lately...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy appears to be so eager<n>to search for
posts about herself that<n>she hasn't been getting
much sleep...
